editorial.blurb: Mammoth Poke Bucktown serves up fresh, generous poke bowls and creative sushi burritos at fair prices in a casual neighborhood spot.
editorial.insiderTip: Order the Logan bowl or build your own—at $13.95, it's a great value for the city. Grab a Thai Iced Tea Lemonade on the side and snag a seat in their outdoor area during warmer months.
